Read MS2 consensus data into a named list

read_ms2_consensus.Rd

Converts MS2 consensus data into a named list keyed by feature_name, ready for run_isf_annotation().

Three input types accepted:

Option A

Spectra from combineSpectra() — empty spectra removed automatically.

Option B

Spectra already filtered (ms2_final <- ms2_consensus[lengths(mz(ms2_consensus)) > 0]).

Option C

Path to an MGF file with feature_name= headers.

When feature_table is provided, the MS2 scan RT (DDA ) is replaced by the MS1 peak apex RT (rtmed) from the feature table. This unifies MS2 and MS1 RT at source, preventing spurious RT differences of up to ~20 s caused by DDA firing on the rising edge of a chromatographic peak.

Usage

read_ms2_consensus(x, feature_table = NULL, ppm_check = 20, verbose = TRUE)

Arguments

x

Spectra object or MGF file path.

feature_table

data.frame. Optional MS1 feature table with columns feature_name and mzmed/mz and rtmed/rt. When provided:

  • MS2 RT is overridden with MS1 apex RT.

  • Precursor m/z is cross-checked within ppm_check.

ppm_check

Numeric. ppm tolerance for precursor m/z check. Default 20.

verbose

Logical. Print summary. Default TRUE.

Value

Named list keyed by feature_name. Each element:

feature_name

Character.

precursor_mz

Numeric.

rt

Numeric. MS1 apex RT (seconds) if feature_table provided; otherwise MS2 scan RT.

fragment_mz

Numeric vector.

fragment_int

Numeric vector.

n_fragments

Integer.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
# Option A — ms2_consensus directly (empty spectra removed inside)
ms2_list <- read_ms2_consensus(ms2_consensus, feature_table = pool_ft)

# Option B — pre-filtered ms2_final
ms2_final <- ms2_consensus[lengths(mz(ms2_consensus)) > 0]
ms2_list  <- read_ms2_consensus(ms2_final, feature_table = pool_ft)

# Option C — MGF file
ms2_list  <- read_ms2_consensus("xcms_ms2_consensus_final.mgf",
                                 feature_table = pool_ft)
} # }
